title: Establish PRD review rota, dependency heatmap, and early-legal flagging
creator: Marco Ruiz
description: Create and pilot a repeatable cross-functional PRD review process: (1) a lightweight rota for synchronous review windows so stakeholders can commit to attendance; (2) a dependency heatmap artifact that surfaces blockers and legal/privacy flags; (3) an 'early-legal' flag flow so Legal is notified the moment a PRD touches data/control-plane or export surfaces. The outcome should reduce last-minute scope truncations and clarify owner SLAs.
acceptance_criteria: Rota template with named backup contacts published in Confluence
Heatmap template (CSV + Confluence) populated for pilot PRDs and validated by owners
Early-legal flagging checklist accepted by Legal and on the PRD template
Pilot demonstrates measurable improvement: average signoff latency reduced and fewer scope cuts
